source.sourceTextureRule: selected material AlbedoPBR, DiffusePBR or DiffuseColor texture

rootCause.observed: R0.12.1 showed no visible difference although Opacity appeared enabled.
rootCause.codeDefect: the generated diagnostic texture stored coverage only in PNG alpha while RGB remained white; an opacity implementation sampling grayscale RGB therefore read the map as fully opaque
rootCause.interactionDefect: the workbench waited for a manual material click and did not automatically prove that the Opacity channel changed the rendered result

correction.maskEncoding: coverage is copied to R, G, B and A simultaneously
correction.fallback: border chroma-key from the source atlas; if source image access fails, apply an explicit grayscale channel probe
correction.visualSelfTest: capture source and calibrated frames from matching viewers and calculate changed-pixel ratio plus mean RGB difference

atlasExtraction.filter: single 3x3 coverage blur for diagnostic fringe
atlasExtraction.output: grayscale RGBA PNG aligned to the source atlas UV

requiredVisibleEvidence: before and after differ by more than one percent of compared pixels
gray backing outside feather silhouettes disappears or is substantially reduced
edge fringe is narrow instead of whole-feather glass transparency
no black or gray halo on bright gray, sky blue and warm gray backgrounds
no phase-dependent flicker across eight normalized animation phases
